value.answer: Sorry you're going through something hard enough to need a therapist. In Toronto, Psychotherapy Referral Service is a not-for-profit that connects people with registered psychotherapists, and you can contact them from their profiles. If your work has an Employee Assistance Program, it may cover a few free sessions a year, and private therapy is often covered by an extended health plan through an employer. For free or low-cost options, the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program offers free short-term CBT for adults with depression or anxiety, and Family Service Toronto has sliding-scale fees based on income. If it gets urgent, ConnexOntario is open 24 hours at 1-866-531-2600, and Distress Centres of Greater Toronto offers free 24/7 support by hotline, chat or text.
